description: This PHP class 'DataGroupPermissionCollection' extends 'AttributeBag' and manages a collection of permissions related to data groups, providing a method to convert these permissions into an array format suitable for further processing or serialization.

classes.name: DataGroupPermissionCollection
classes.description: Represents a collection of permissions for data groups, enabling transformation into array form.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the permissions collection into an array where each data group maps to its set of CRUD permissions.
